entries.category_description: Until 1 January 2030: Wood used as firewood
entries.comment: Firewood in logs, stumps, twigs or faggots; wood waste, including sawdust but excluding pellets (CN code 4401 31 00).

entries.category_description: Solid mineral fuels; mineral oils and wood for use as fuel
entries.comment: Wood other than used as firewood

The supply for the use as heating fuel of sawdust, waste and non-agglomerated wood scraps, carried out to final beneficiaries, on the basis of a statement of liability made available to the supplier. See art. 291 para. (2) letters i), j) of the Fiscal Code.
